request: I'm flying home to London for my home leave on March 12th. Premium economy if I'm entitled to it; otherwise economy.

trip.purpose: Home leave under the traveller's expatriate contract
trip.funding: Core funds of the Eastern and Southern Africa regional office
notes: The traveller is a British national posted to the Nairobi office; the contract gives home leave travel every year.

must_keep.quote: The policy covers work -related travel and individual travel entitlements provided for under contracts of employment, e.g. home leave for expatriate staff.
must_keep.why: the policy covers contractual entitlements such as home leave

must_keep.quote: a) Economy plus/premium class1 is allowed for total flying time of over 8 hours
must_keep.why: economy plus/premium for total flying time over eight hours

must_keep.quote: The TA must be approved by the traveller's line manager prior to travel and before any commitments are made.
must_keep.why: the line manager approves the TA before any commitment

distractors.quote: Please note that Home Leave travel is excluded from the IUCN Global Travel Insurance policy.
distractors.why: home leave is outside the insurance, not outside the travel policy

design_notes: Lines 76-77: the policy covers individual travel entitlements under contracts of employment, e.g. home leave for expatriate staff, so the flight is bought under it. At 520 minutes the flight is over eight hours, so premium economy is allowed (line 253): the cheapest, British Airways at CHF 1,140. The insurance exclusion for home leave (line 134) does not take the trip out of the travel policy.
